responsibility: Coordinates variance inference for the crate by registering the variance queries, running the term-collection, constraint-building, and solving pipeline for inferable items, and serving per-item variance results including the special computation used for opaque and RPITIT-associated types.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the variance-inference entry point: it registers `variances_of`/`crate_variances`, runs the terms→constraints→solver pipeline over inferable generic parameters, and serves per-item variance tables, rather than checking bodies/impls or lowering HIR types.
